title: Vocabolar dl ladin leterar 1/Vocabolario del ladino letterario1/Wörterbuch des literarischen Ladinisch 1
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This corpus-based vocabulary examines Ladin literature prior to 1879, including the variations in all valley idioms, etymology, first mention, definition of the different meanings as well as a rich exemplification through evidence from more than 200 text of the earliest Ladin literature.
